name: inv-6-one-red-then-green-era-test
description: Whether a TaskGraph is I6-era (red-then-green owed when new tests are required), and which test-file classification it owes it under, is decided only by frozenRedThenGreenEra(frozenManifest) in engine/src/core/proof-obligations.ts, the one reader of the frozen manifest's testFiles. Population, the state-file-wire obligation-match check and task revalidation ask through redThenGreenEra, and settlement, the stored-evidence reconcile and the brief through redThenGreenDuty (implementation-application.ts), so they cannot disagree about which graphs owe I6 (G4 slice 2, FR-005, FR-010, ADR-0025). This rule refuses an inline presence test or read of the testFiles field anywhere else: an equality on either side, a negation, an `in` test, optional chaining and `??`. verification-manifest.ts is excluded because it parses and freezes that field.
fixHint: Call frozenRedThenGreenEra(graph.verification_manifest) (or redThenGreenEra for the era alone) from engine/src/core/proof-obligations.ts instead of reading or testing testFiles inline.
